blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.
blocks.zh: 多式联运离散散式语言模型(dLLMs)通过迭代掩码预测产生响应,为自递式大型视觉语言模型提供了一个有希望的替代方案. 然而,他们仍然受到幻觉的影响,其产出在语言前言中是可信的,但是在形象上没有足够扎根。 我们提出,在多式联运 dLLMs 中的幻觉不仅是一个象征性的预测问题,而且是一个过早的承诺问题:在迭代解密期间,一些蒙面的立场被揭开太早,因为其信心更多地是由语言前身而不是视觉证据驱动的,这些早期的承诺会偏向后代. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了Visual Gain Ordering(VIGOR),这是一种没有训练的插头和游戏推论策略,根据反事实的视觉证据重新排列蒙面位置. 在每一个解密步骤上,VIGOR在原图像条件的通行证和额外的视觉缩写通行证下比较每个候选信使的自信,并优先排列其预测得到图像更有力支持的位置. 关于LLaDA-V和Lumina-DimoO的实验表明,VIGOR不断减少幻觉,提高跨基准的多式联运推理性能. 代码见https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in large vision-language models have enabled strong performance on a wide range of multimodal tasks, including visual question answering, image-grounded dialogue, and multimodal reasoning [ 25 , 31 , 55 , 3 , 42 ] . Beyond conventional autoregressive LVLMs, recent work has begun to explore multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), which generate responses through iterative mask prediction rather than left-to-right decoding [ 12 , 65 , 54 , 33 , 58 , 51 , 53 , 26 ] . By refining multiple positions in parallel, multimodal dLLMs offer a fundamentally different decoding paradigm with promising advantages in efficiency and controllability [ 48 , 2 , 52 , 67 ] . However, they still suffer from hallucination: the generated response may be plausible under language priors while remaining insufficiently grounded in the image [ 37 , 28 , 15 , 4 , 11 , 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近在大型视觉语言模型方面取得的进展,使多种模式的任务得以取得强有力的业绩,包括视觉问答、图像对话以及多式联运推理[25、31、55、3、42]。 除了传统的自动递减LVLM外,最近还开始探索多式联运离散扩散语言模型(dLLM),通过迭代掩码预测而不是左到右的解码生成响应[12,65,54,33,58,51,53,26]. 通过平行地完善多个位置,多式联运dLLMs提供了一个根本不同的解码模式,在效率和可控性方面有希望的优势[48、2、52、67]。 然而,他们仍然受到幻觉的折磨:在语言前言下,产生的反应可能是可信的,而对于图像则没有足够的依据[37、28、15、4、11、36]。

blocks.en: Although hallucination has been widely studied in autoregressive LVLMs, the failure mode in multimodal dLLMs is importantly different. In autoregressive decoding, hallucination is typically viewed as a token selection problem, where the model over-predicts linguistically plausible but visually unsupported tokens due to strong language priors or weak visual grounding [ 43 , 23 , 21 ] . In multimodal dLLMs, by contrast, generation proceeds through iterative denoising, where the decoder must decide not only what token to predict, but also when each masked position should be committed. Existing blockwise decoders usually rank masked positions by confidence and unmask the top-ranked ones first [ 33 , 17 ] . However, this confidence can be misleading in multimodal settings. As shown in Figure 1 , an autoregressive LVLM may predict golfer because the phrase “golf club” in the prompt induces an overly strong language prior. A multimodal dLLM can amplify this failure: the position corresponding to golf , which is highly confident due to the same prior rather than visual evidence, may be committed too early and bias subsequent denoising toward golfer . Therefore, hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not merely a prediction error, but also a premature commitment problem.
blocks.zh: 虽然幻觉在自递性LVLMs中被广泛研究,但多式联运dLLMs中的故障模式却大不相同. 在自动退缩解码中,幻觉通常被视为一种符号选择问题,模型过度预测语言上可信但视觉上不支持的符号,因为语言前题强或视觉定位薄弱[43,23,21]. 相比之下,在多式联运 dLLMs 中,生成通过迭代解码来进行,其中解码器不仅必须决定要预测什么符号,而且还必须决定何时要执行每个蒙蔽的位置. 现有的区块解码器通常通过置信度对蒙面位置进行排位,并首先解码排名最高的[33,17]. 然而,这种信心在多式联运环境中可能具有误导性。 如图1所示,自递性LVLM可能预测高尔夫球手,因为即时的“高尔夫俱乐部”一词会诱发一种过于强烈的语言。 多模式 dLLM 能放大这种失败: 高尔夫球的对应位置, 因此,在多式联运 dLLMs 中出现幻觉不仅仅是一个预测错误,而且也是一个过早的承诺问题.

blocks.en: This difference makes existing hallucination mitigation strategies less suitable for multimodal dLLMs. Prior methods mainly fall into three categories: fine-tuning with additional supervision [ 41 , 20 , 59 , 61 , 63 , 6 ] , perceptual enhancement with auxiliary visual signals [ 7 , 32 , 1 , 47 , 56 , 9 ] , and inference-time contrastive decoding or logit correction [ 27 , 8 , 24 , 16 , 46 , 22 , 30 , 50 , 66 , 62 , 35 ] . While effective for autoregressive LVLMs, these methods mainly target which token should be generated, but do not directly address which positions should be committed earlier or later during iterative denoising. As a result, they are not designed for the distinctive hallucination mechanism of multimodal dLLMs.
blocks.zh: 这种差异使得现有的幻觉缓解战略更不适合多式联运 dLLMs. 以往方法主要分为三类: 附加监督的微调 [41, 20, 59, 61, 63, 6], 带有辅助视觉信号的知觉增强 [7, 32, 1, 47, 56, 9], 推论时间对比解码或登录校正 [27, 8, 24, 16, 46, 22, 30, 50, 66, 62, 35]. 这些方法虽然对自动递减LVLM有效,但主要针对应生成哪一个符号,但并不直接涉及在迭代解控过程中应提前或后期实施哪些位置。 因此,它们不是为多式联运dLLMs独特的幻觉机制设计的。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose Vi sual G ain Or dering ( Vigor ), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy for multimodal discrete diffusion language models. Instead of modifying model parameters or redesigning the decoder, Vigor intervenes only in the commitment order of masked positions. The key idea is to prioritize positions whose current predictions are genuinely supported by the image. To estimate such support, Vigor introduces a counterfactual visual-ablation pass during decoding. At each denoising step, the model first performs the standard image-conditioned forward pass, and then an additional visual-ablation pass with the visual input ablated. By comparing the confidence of the same candidate token across the two passes, Vigor measures its visual gain , i.e., how much the current prediction depends on the image rather than on language priors alone. As illustrated in Figure 1 , this allows the model to commit visually grounded cues such as Curry earlier, while deferring prior-dominated tokens such as golf . As a result, subsequent denoising is steered toward the correct answer basketball player , rather than being prematurely biased toward golfer .
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用Vi sual G ain or dering(Vigor),作为多式联运离散传播语言模式的无培训和插播和游戏推断战略。 Vigor没有修改模型参数或重新设计解码器,而是只介入蒙面位置的承诺顺序. 关键的想法是确定当前预测得到图像真正支持的位置的优先次序。 为了估计这种支持,Vigor在解码时引入了反事实视觉比对通道. 在每一个解诺步骤上,模型首先执行标准图像条件前传,然后附加一个视觉输入减速的可视化传. 通过比较两个通行证上同一候选符号的置信度,维戈尔衡量其视觉收益,即当前预测的多少取决于图像而不是语言前缀. 如图1所示,这允许模型在稍早时执行视觉上固定的提示,如咖哩,同时推迟使用先前占主导地位的标志,如高尔夫球。 而不是过早偏向高尔夫球员。

blocks.en: In this way, Vigor turns decoding in multimodal dLLMs into an evidence-grounded commitment process. Rather than changing which token a position prefers, it changes when that position is allowed to become committed. Because Vigor only replaces the ordering criterion while keeping the original blockwise decoding pipeline intact, it is model-agnostic and requires no retraining. Extensive experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that Vigor consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 通过这种方式,Vigor将多式联运 dLLMs中的解码变成了一个有证据依据的承诺过程. 它不是改变一个立场所偏爱的标志,而是在允许该立场作出承诺时改变。 因为Vigor只取代订购标准,同时保持原有的阻断式解码管道完好无损,所以它具有模型不可知性,不需要再培训. 对LLaDA-V和Lumina-DimoO的广泛实验表明,Vigor一贯减少幻觉,并改进跨基准的多式联运推理表现。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运扩散模式

blocks.en: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) [ 12 , 65 , 54 , 40 , 38 , 33 , 60 ] replace autoregressive, left-to-right decoding with iterative demasking under bidirectional attention. Recent work extends this paradigm to multimodal inputs: LLaDA-V [ 58 ] , Lumina-DiMOO [ 51 ] , MMaDA [ 53 ] , and LaViDa [ 26 ] couple a visual encoder with a dLLM through a lightweight projection module [ 25 , 31 , 55 , 3 , 42 ] , forming an emerging class of multimodal dLLMs (mdLLMs). A parallel line of work further improves the efficiency and controllability of dLLM decoding [ 48 , 2 , 14 , 67 , 52 ] .
blocks.zh: 分散传播语言模型(dLLMs)[12,65,54,40,38,33,60]在双向关注下用迭代解码取代自旋,左对右解码. 近期的工作将这一范式扩展到多式联运投入:LLaDA-V [58],Lumina-Dimo [51],MMADA [53],以及LaVida [26]通过轻量级投影模块将一个视觉编码器与dLLLM [25, 31, 55, 3, 42] , 形成新兴的多模式dLLM(mdLLM)类. 平行的工作路线进一步提高dLLM解码的效率和可控性[48,2,14,67,52].

blocks.en: The decoding mechanism of mdLLMs differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive LVLMs [ 44 , 34 , 42 ] . Rather than generating tokens one at a time in left-to-right order, an mdLLM predicts candidate tokens for all currently masked positions in parallel and then commits a confidence-ranked subset at each denoising step. This confidence-based blockwise decoding is central to our setting: because the commitment order is decided online, positions dominated by language priors can receive high confidence and be exposed too early, even when they are not supported by the image [ 43 , 23 , 21 ] . Once committed, such tokens become visible to the remaining masked positions through bidirectional attention, allowing hallucinated content to propagate and reinforce itself across later denoising steps.
blocks.zh: mdLLMs的解码机制与自递性LVLMs[44,34,42]的解码机制有着根本的不同. MdLLM不一次以左向右顺序生成一个符号,而是对目前所有蒙面位置的候选符号进行平行的预测,然后在每个去名步骤上执行一个信任级子集. 这种基于信心的块形解码是我们设定的核心:因为承诺顺序是在线决定的,所以以语言前辈为主的位置可以获得很高的置信度,被曝光得太早,即使这些位置没有图像支持[43,23,21]. 一旦实施,通过双向关注,这些象征物就能够被其余的蒙面姿势所看到,从而使幻觉中的内容在后来的虚名步骤中传播和加强自己。

blocks.en: 2.2 Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 LVLMs中的缓解幻觉

blocks.en: A large body of work addresses hallucination in autoregressive LVLMs [ 37 , 28 , 10 , 19 , 64 , 23 , 49 , 15 ] . Existing approaches fall into three categories: training-time supervision [ 41 , 20 , 59 , 61 , 63 , 6 ] , perceptual enhancement via attention or activation intervention [ 7 , 32 , 1 , 47 , 56 , 9 , 13 , 5 , 57 ] , and inference-time contrastive or modified decoding [ 27 , 8 , 24 , 16 , 46 , 22 , 30 , 50 , 66 , 62 , 35 ] . Despite this diversity, all such methods target autoregressive generation, where token order is fixed and hallucination mitigation acts on token preference under a left-to-right prefix.
blocks.zh: 大量工作涉及自递性LVLMs[37,28,10,19,64,23,49,15]中的幻觉. 现行办法分为三类:培训时间监督[41,20,59,61,63,6],通过关注或激活干预增强知觉[7,32,1,47,56,9,13,5,57],推论时间对比或修改解码[27,8,24,16,46,22,30,50,66,62,35]. 尽管有这种多样性,但所有这类方法都针对自动递归生成,在这种生成中,象征性的顺序固定下来,幻觉减缓作用在从左到右前缀下的象征性偏好下.

blocks.en: This assumption breaks down in multimodal dLLMs, where masked positions are updated in parallel and the commitment order is decided dynamically during denoising. A handful of concurrent works begin to analyze hallucination in dLLMs and explore remedies such as remasking [ 4 , 11 , 17 ] , but they target text-only dLLMs and leave the interaction between visual evidence and language priors in multimodal decoding unaddressed. Consequently, existing hallucination mitigation methods do not provide a native solution for multimodal dLLMs.
blocks.zh: 这种假设在多模式 dLLMs 中分解,其中蒙面位置平行更新,承诺顺序在解密时动态决定. 少数并行的作品开始分析dLLMs中的幻觉,并探索重现[4,11,17]等补救方法,但它们针对的只是文本的dLLMs,并留下了可视证据和语言前缀在多式联运解码中的相互作用. 因此,现有的缓解幻觉的方法并不能为多式联运 dLLMs提供本土的解决办法。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We present Vi sual G ain Or dering ( Vigor ). Vigor is a training-free, plug-and-play inference strategy for multimodal dLLMs that reorders the commitment of masked positions according to visual evidence. Rather than modifying model parameters or redesigning the decoder, Vigor intervenes only in which positions are committed earlier during iterative denoising.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Vi sual G ain or dering(维戈尔). Vigor是一种对多式dLLMs进行无训练,插座和游戏的推断策略,根据视觉证据重新排序蒙面位置的承诺. Vigor不是修改模型参数或重新设计解码器,而是只干预在迭代解码时较早时所承诺的位置。

blocks.en: The standard confidence c i ( s ) c_{i}^{(s)} in blockwise decoding does not reveal whether a candidate token is supported by the image or merely by language priors. To estimate this dependency, Vigor introduces a counterfactual visual-ablation pass at each denoising step. In addition to the standard image-conditioned distribution p i , img ( s ) = p θ ​ ( y i ∣ I , q , 𝐳 ( s ) ) , i ∈ ℳ ( s ) , p_{i,\mathrm{img}}^{(s)}=p_{\theta}\bigl(y_{i}\mid I,q,\mathbf{z}^{(s)}\bigr),\qquad i\in\mathcal{M}^{(s)}, (4) we run a second forward pass with the visual input ablated while keeping the text context and the partially generated response unchanged: p i , noimg ( s ) = p θ ​ ( y i ∣ ∅ , q , 𝐳 ( s ) ) , i ∈ ℳ ( s ) . p_{i,\mathrm{noimg}}^{(s)}=p_{\theta}\bigl(y_{i}\mid\varnothing,q,\mathbf{z}^{(s)}\bigr),\qquad i\in\mathcal{M}^{(s)}. Instead, it provides a counterfactual confidence for the same candidate token selected by the image-conditioned pass. If this candidate remains highly confident after visual ablation, its preference is likely dominated by language priors; if its confidence drops substantially, the candidate is more likely to be visually grounded. This contrast forms the basis of Vigor .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate Vigor on two recent multimodal discrete diffusion language models and three hallucination-sensitive benchmarks that together cover yes/no object probing, open-ended caption hallucination, and mixed generative–discriminative grounding.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了维戈尔最近的两个多模式分散传播语言模型和三个对幻觉敏感的基准,这些基准共同涵盖"是/否"的探测,开放式的字幕幻觉,以及混合的基因差异定位。

blocks.en: Datasets and metrics. We report results on POPE [ 28 ] , CHAIR [ 37 ] , and AMBER [ 45 ] . POPE is a benchmark for assessing whether LVLMs can correctly recognize the presence of specific objects in images, thereby exposing object-level hallucinations. It uses balanced yes/no questions with random, popular, and adversarial sampling strategies, and draws from MSCOCO [ 29 ] , A-OKVQA [ 39 ] , and GQA [ 18 ] . Following the standard setup, we report accuracy and F1 on all nine subsets. CHAIR evaluates hallucination in open-ended image captioning. We follow the common setting based on 500 randomly sampled images from COCO 2014 val [ 29 ] and report CHAIR S and CHAIR I , where lower values indicate fewer hallucinated objects. AMBER provides a broader benchmark for hallucination and grounding quality through both generative and discriminative tasks. For the generative part, we report CHAIR, Cover, Hal, and Cog; for the discriminative part, we report Acc and F1.
blocks.zh: 数据集和衡量标准。 我们报告关于POPE[28]、主席[37]和AMBER[45]的结果。 POPE是评估LVLM能否正确识别图像中特定物体的存在,从而暴露物体级幻觉的基准. 它使用随机、流行和对抗性抽样策略的均衡的“是/否”问题,并借鉴了MCCO [29]、A-OKVQA [39] 和GQA [18]。 按照标准设置,我们报告所有9个子集的准确性和F1. ChAIR在开放式图像字幕中评价幻觉. 我们遵循基于来自COCO 2014 val [29] 的500个随机抽样图像的共同设定,并报告CHAIR S和CHAIR I,其中数值较低表明幻觉物体较少. AMBER通过基因和歧视性任务为幻觉和定位质量提供了更广泛的基准。 关于基因部分,我们报告主席、封面、哈尔和科格;关于歧视部分,我们报告Acc和F1。

blocks.en: Baseline models. We evaluate Vigor on two state-of-the-art multimodal discrete diffusion language models, LLaDA-V [ 58 ] and Lumina-DiMOO [ 51 ] . For each model, we compare Vigor with vanilla decoding and two representative inference-time hallucination mitigation baselines, ICT and VCD. Details of how ICT [ 5 ] and VCD [ 24 ] are adapted to multimodal dLLM decoding are provided in Appendix C . All methods keep the underlying weights and prompt format unchanged, thereby isolating the effect of inference-time decoding interventions.
blocks.zh: 基线模型。 我们评价了Vigor两种最先进的多式联运分散传播语言模式,LLaDA-V[58]和Lumina-DimoO[51]。 对于每个模型,我们比较Vigor与香草解码以及两个有代表性的推论时间幻觉缓解基线,即信通技术和VCD. 附录C详细介绍了信通技术[5]和VCD[24]如何适应多式联运dLLLM解码。 所有方法都使基础权重和即时格式保持不变,从而隔离了推断时间解码干预的效果.

blocks.en: Implementation details. Vigor is applied only at inference time. At each decoding step, we run the standard image-conditioned forward pass together with a visual-ablation pass, compute the ordering score in Eq. 7 , and use it to select the top- k k masked positions inside the current block. We keep the generation length, block schedule, and base model parameters unchanged and only replace the ranking rule used for blockwise commitment. The baseline and Vigor share the same blockwise decoding configuration. All experiments use greedy decoding (temperature = 0 =0 ), so the baseline and Vigor differ only in the ranking score s i s_{i} and the runs are deterministic given fixed inputs. All experiments are conducted on 3 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 维戈尔只在推断时间适用. 在每一个解码步骤,我们运行标准图像条件前传与可视化的传球,计算Eq. 7的定购分数,并用它来选择当前块内最高的-k k 遮掩位置. 我们保持生成长度,块表,和基模型参数不变,只取代用于块化承诺的排名规则. 基线和Vigor共享相同的区块解码配置. 所有实验都使用贪婪的解码(温度=0=0),因此基准和维戈尔仅在排名分数s i s_{i}中存在差异,运行是确定给定的固定输入. 所有实验都用3个NVIDIA A100 GPU进行.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on POPE
blocks.zh: 4.2 关于持久性有机污染物的结果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the results of LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO on nine subsets of the POPE dataset. In addition to the vanilla baseline, we compare with two representative inference-time hallucination mitigation methods originally proposed for autoregressive LVLMs, VCD [ 24 ] and ICT [ 5 ] , which we adapt to multimodal dLLM decoding by applying their logit-correction rule at every denoising step (see Appendix C for how these baselines are adapted to mask-diffusion decoding). From these results, we make the following observations.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了LLaDA-V和Lumina-DimoO对POPE数据集9个子集的结果。 除了香草基线之外,我们还比较了最初为自递性LVLMs、VCD[24]和ICT[5]提出的两种有代表性的推论-时间幻觉减缓方法,我们通过在每一解码步骤适用其记录校正规则来适应这些方法(这些基准如何适应遮罩-扩散解码,见附录C)。 根据这些结果,我们提出以下意见。

blocks.en: 1) Vigor consistently outperforms the vanilla baseline as well as the VCD and ICT baselines on every subset and every model, demonstrating that visual-gain-based reordering is effective even for simple yes/no object grounding. On average, Vigor improves accuracy by 4.7 4.7 points and F1 by 3.1 3.1 points over the vanilla baseline for LLaDA-V, and improves accuracy by 2.6 2.6 points and F1 by 8.3 8.3 points for Lumina-DiMOO. The gains over the next-best inference-time baseline (VCD or ICT) are also consistent across all nine subsets, indicating that the benefit of Vigor comes from the commitment-order intervention itself rather than from generic logit-level correction. 2) The improvements are more pronounced on the popular and adversarial splits, where language-prior-driven mistakes are more likely to occur. For example, on the COCO popular split, F1 increases from 76.8 76.8 to 80.5 80.5 for LLaDA-V and from 66.8 66.8 to 79.3 79.3 for Lumina-DiMOO; on the COCO adversarial split, F1 improves from 76.3 76.3 to 78.9 78.9 and from 65.1 65.1 to 74.8 74.8 , respectively. Similar trends are observed on A-OKVQA and GQA, suggesting that Vigor brings larger benefits when the benchmark places stronger pressure on language priors. 3) The two models show different gain profiles: LLaDA-V obtains larger average gains in accuracy, while Lumina-DiMOO benefits more substantially in F1. We attribute this difference to model-dependent calibration, but the consistent improvements across all subsets confirm the robustness and model-agnostic effectiveness of Vigor .
blocks.zh: 1) Vigor持续超过香草基线以及每个子集和每个模型上的VCD和信通技术基线,表明基于视觉的重排甚至对简单的是/否抛锚也是有效的。 维戈尔平均比LLaDA-V的香草基线提高精度4.7分,F1提高3.1分,而Lumina-DimoO的精度提高2.6分,F1提高8.3分. 在下一个最佳推断时间基线(VCD或信通技术)上的收益在所有9个子集中也是一致的,表明维戈尔的好处来自承诺令干预本身,而不是通用的对数级修正. 2)在受欢迎的和对抗性的分裂中,改进更为明显,在这些分裂中,语言优先驱动的错误更有可能发生. 例如,在COCO流行的拆分中,LLaDA-V的F1从76.876.8增加到80.580.5,Lumina-DimoO从66.866.8增加到79.379.3;COCO对抗的拆分中,F1分别从76.376.3增加到78.978.9和65.165.1增加到74.874.8。 在A-OKVQA和GQA上也观察到类似的趋势,这表明当基准对语言前辈施加更大的压力时,Vigor会带来更大的效益. 3)两种模型显示不同的增益配置:LLaDA-V在精度上获得更大的平均增益,而Lumina-DimoO在F1中则受益更大. 我们将此差异归因于依赖模型的校准,但所有子集的一致改进证实了维戈尔的稳健性和模型不可知的有效性.

blocks.en: 1) Vigor consistently reduces caption hallucination for both models at both output lengths. Averaged over lengths 64 64 and 512 512 , Vigor reduces CHAIR S by 6.50 6.50 points for both LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO, and reduces CHAIR I by 4.05 4.05 points on LLaDA-V and 7.40 7.40 points on Lumina-DiMOO. blocks.en: Figure 3 probes whether Vigor changes commitment order in the intended direction. Vigor does not change the generator itself; it changes when each masked position is allowed to become visible to subsequent denoising steps. To measure visual sensitivity, we use the step- 0 0 Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD) between the image-conditioned and no-image token distributions: JSD ( p i img , p i noimg ) = 1 2 KL ( p i img ∥ m i ) + 1 2 KL ( p i noimg ∥ m i ) , m i = 1 2 ( p i img + p i noimg ) . \mathrm{JSD}(p_{i}^{\mathrm{img}},p_{i}^{\mathrm{noimg}})=\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{KL}(p_{i}^{\mathrm{img}}\|m_{i})+\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{KL}(p_{i}^{\mathrm{noimg}}\|m_{i}),\quad m_{i}=\frac{1}{2}(p_{i}^{\mathrm{img}}+p_{i}^{\mathrm{noimg}}). A larger JSD indicates stronger sensitivity to visual ablation. Figure 3 (a) shows that the baseline tends to commit low-JSD positions earlier, whereas Vigor shifts earlier commitments toward high-JSD positions. Figure 3 (b) further shows that positions advanced by Vigor have higher step- 0 0 JSD than those not advanced, with 44.2 % 44.2\% of analyzed positions committed earlier under Vigor . Figure 3 (d) shows that this reordering propagates through decoding: the candidate-token difference ratio grows across decoding steps. Together, these results indicate that Vigor intervenes at the commitment-order level, exposing visually sensitive positions earlier and deferring less image-dependent ones.

blocks.en: 5.3 Cascade Suppression
blocks.zh: 5.3 连带抑制

blocks.en: The main experiments show that Vigor consistently reduces hallucination. Figure 3 (c) helps explain why: on incorrect samples in the LLaDA-V AMBER analysis, the early-stage unstable commit rate drops from 50.2 % 50.2\% under the baseline to 26.0 % 26.0\% under Vigor . This matters in multimodal dLLMs because decoding uses bidirectional attention: once an unstable position is committed too early, it becomes visible to the remaining masked positions through bidirectional attention, cascading the error into subsequent denoising steps. Reducing such early hallucinated anchors therefore prevents later error propagation. Combined with Figures 3 (a) and 3 (b), this supports a single mechanism: Vigor advances positions that are more sensitive to visual evidence and suppresses unstable early commitments before they spread through later decoding.
blocks.zh: 主要实验表明,维戈尔持续减少幻觉. 图3(c)有助于解释为什么:在LLaDA-V AMBER分析中的不正确的样本中,早期不稳定的承诺率从基线下的50.2%50.2%下降到了Vigor下的26.0%26.0%。 这在多式联运 dLLMs 中很重要,因为解码使用双向注意:一旦一个不稳定的位置被承诺得太早,它通过双向注意而变得对剩余的蒙面位置可见,将错误带入后续的解码步骤. 因此,减少这种早期幻觉锚可以防止以后的错误传播。 这与图3(a)和图3(b)相结合,支持单一机制: Vigor推进了对视觉证据更加敏感的位置,并在通过后来的解码传播之前抑制了不稳定的早期承诺.

blocks.zh: 5.4 案例研究和错误分析

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares vanilla decoding and Vigor on two examples, with hallucinated tokens highlighted in red. In the left case, vanilla decoding introduces several prior-driven dining co-occurrences, such as a dog, an extra cup of orange juice, and a knife and fork, none of which are supported by the image. In contrast, Vigor produces a more grounded description by correctly mentioning the coffee cup, bread, juice, and background chairs. In the right case, vanilla decoding hallucinates template-like tennis-scene details, including a red tie, a bench, and a visible tennis ball. Vigor removes these unsupported details and better captures the cap, striped shirt, jumping pose, and person on the side. However, it still misidentifies the player’s gender, suggesting that Vigor mitigates prior-driven hallucinations but cannot correct recognition errors inherited from the base model.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We argue that hallucination in multimodal discrete diffusion language models is not only a token-prediction error but also a premature commitment problem. To address this, we propose Vigor , a training-free plug-and-play inference method that controls when masked positions commit during iterative denoising. By comparing the confidence of the same candidate token under image-conditioned and visual-ablation passes, Vigor prioritizes positions supported by visual evidence and defers those dominated by language priors. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO across benchmarks show that changing the commitment order alone consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning. Diagnostic analysis further confirms that Vigor advances image-sensitive positions, defers less visually dependent ones, and suppresses unstable early commitments.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,多式联运离散传播语言模型中的幻觉不仅是一个象征性的预测错误,而且是一个过早的承诺问题。 为了解决这个问题,我们建议维戈尔(Vigor),一种无训练的插头和游戏推论方法,当蒙面位置在迭代解密时进行控制. 通过比较同一候选信物在图像条件和视觉缩写通行证下的信心,维戈尔优先排列有视觉证据支持的位置,并推迟那些以语言前科为主的位置. 关于LLaDA-V和Lumina-DimoO的跨基准实验表明,单是改变承诺顺序就能够不断减少幻觉,改进多式联运推理。 诊断分析进一步证实,Vigor推进了对图像敏感的位置,推迟了视觉依赖程度较低的位置,并抑制了不稳定的早期承诺.

blocks.en: Limitations. Vigor requires an additional no-image forward pass at each denoising step, roughly doubling decoding time in our experiments. It also requires access to internal decoding scores and control over the commitment schedule, making it most suitable for open-weight or controllable models. Future work will explore more efficient variants and broader model settings.
blocks.zh: 限制。 Vigor需要额外的无图像前传 在每一个解码步骤, 大约加倍的解码时间 在我们的实验。 它还要求获取内部解码分数和控制承诺时间表,使其最适合开放量级或可控模式. 今后的工作将探索更有效的变体和更广泛的模型设置。

blocks.en: Appendix A Backbone Models
blocks.zh: 附录 A 背骨模型

blocks.en: We evaluate Vigor on two open-source multimodal discrete diffusion language models, LLaDA-V [ 58 ] and Lumina-DiMOO [ 51 ] . Although both use discrete diffusion as the decoding paradigm, they differ in how the visual modality enters the model, which is relevant for how the visual-ablation pass in Vigor is implemented.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Vigor两种开源多式离散传播语言模式,LLaDA-V[58]和Lumina-DimoO[51]。 虽然两者都使用离散扩散作为解码范式,但是在视觉模式如何进入模型上却有所不同,这与维戈尔的视觉比喻是如何执行的有关.

blocks.en: LLaDA-V follows the visual instruction tuning paradigm and uses the LLaDA-8B-Instruct masked diffusion language model as its language tower. Visual inputs are first processed by a SigLIP 2 vision tower ( siglip2-so400m-patch14-384 , 384 × \times 384 input, 729 visual tokens per image) and then projected into LLaDA’s word embedding space by a randomly initialized two-layer MLP. The resulting visual tokens are concatenated as a visual prefix in front of the text tokens, and the language tower performs masked prediction over the answer tokens under bidirectional attention. Because visual inputs enter as continuous projected embeddings, the visual-ablation pass in Vigor is implemented by replacing those embeddings with the [MASK] token embedding while keeping the text tokens and the mask pattern unchanged.
blocks.zh: LLaDA-V遵循视觉指令调制范式,使用LLaDA-8B-Instruct蒙面扩散语言模型作为其语言塔. 视觉输入首先由一个SigLIP 2视觉塔(siglip2-so400m-patch14-384,384 ×\times 384输入,每个图像729个视觉符号)处理,然后通过随机初始化的两层MLP投射到LLADA的词嵌入空间中. 由此产生的视觉符号在文字符号前被装饰成视觉前缀,语言塔在双向注意下对答符号进行蒙面预测. 由于视觉输入作为连续的投影嵌入输入,维戈尔的视觉-缩写通过是通过将那些嵌入替换为[MASK]符号嵌入而实现的,同时保持文字符号和面具图案不变.

blocks.en: Lumina-DiMOO is a unified discrete diffusion model in which both text and images are represented as tokens drawn from a single joint vocabulary. It is initialized from LLaDA-Base without structural modifications and extended to multimodal inputs by adding 8,192 visual tokens from an aMUSEd-VQ image tokenizer (16 × \times 16 downsampling) and a small set of special tokens (e.g., <IMAGE> , </IMAGE> , <end-of-line> ). Each image is converted into a sequence of discrete visual tokens that are interleaved with text tokens in a single sequence, on which the model performs masked prediction under bidirectional full attention; for image understanding, decoding follows LLaDA’s semi-autoregressive blockwise mask-predict schedule. Because the visual input is itself a token sequence rather than continuous embeddings, the visual-ablation pass in Vigor is implemented by replacing those visual tokens with [MASK] tokens while keeping the text tokens and the mask pattern unchanged.
blocks.zh: Lumina-DimoO是一种统一的离散扩散模型,其中文本和图像都作为符号从一个单一的联名词汇中抽出. 它从LLaDA-Base初始化,没有结构修改,并通过从一个AMUSEd-VQ图像标定器(16 ×\time 16 downsampling)中添加8,192个视觉符号和一小组特殊符号(如: " IMAGE " , "/IMAGE " , " 端线 " ),扩展为多式联运输入. 每个图像被转换成一组离散的视觉符号,这些符号在一个序列中与文字符号相交,模型在双向全注意力下进行遮掩的预测;为了图像理解,解码遵循LLaDA的半自动阻隔遮罩预示时间表. 由于视觉输入本身是一个符号序列,而不是连续嵌入,维戈尔的视觉-缩写通过是通过将那些视觉符号替换为[MASK]符号而实现的,同时保持文字符号和面具图案不变.

blocks.en: Appendix C Adapting AR LVLM Inference-Time Baselines to Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Backbones
blocks.zh: 附录C 使AR LVLM 推论-时间基线适应多式联运散射背骨

blocks.en: Mask-diffusion decoding differs from autoregressive decoding in two ways that affect how the inference-time hallucination mitigation methods we use as baselines have to be adapted: every step predicts all masked positions in parallel rather than producing one new token, and the choice of which positions to commit at each step is itself driven by the visual condition through token confidence. This appendix describes how we adapt VCD [ 24 ] and ICT [ 5 ] to LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO under these two properties.
blocks.zh: 遮罩-扩散解码与自动反向解码不同,有两种方式影响我们作为基线使用的推论-时间幻觉减缓方法如何必须调整:每一步骤都以平行方式预测所有遮罩位置,而不是产生一个新的代号,选择每个步骤上要执行的哪个位置本身是由通过象征信任的视觉条件驱动的. 本附录介绍我们如何在这两个属性下将VCD[24]和信通技术[5]适用于LLaDA-V和Lumina-DimoO。

blocks.en: In each backbone’s blockwise mask-diffusion loop, our adaptation follows the same blockwise mask-predict schedule as the vanilla baseline and applies the contrast in Eq. 8 at every denoising step. Three implementation choices are needed to make the per-position contrast well-defined under parallel mask-predict: the two branches are initialized to the same masked sequence and prefix tokens, the same set of transferred tokens is copied into both branches at every denoising step, and the commit decision is driven by the clean side alone. The dual visual condition enters where each backbone naturally consumes vision: at the projected embedding level for LLaDA-V, and at the visual-token level for Lumina-DiMOO.
blocks.zh: 在每一个主干线的阻隔面罩扩散循环中,我们的适应遵循与香草基线相同的阻隔面罩预测时间表,并在每一个去诺步骤上应用Eq.8中的对比. 需要三个执行选择,在平行的遮罩-预设下使每个位置的对比度定义明确:两个分支初始化为相同的遮罩序列和前缀符号,在每一个去诺步骤上将相同的一组转移符号复制到两个分支中,承诺决定由干净的一方独自驱动. 双视条件进入每个主干自然消耗视线的地方:LLaDA-V的预测嵌入级,Lumina-DimoO的可视切入级.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows eight case studies for Lumina-DiMOO (a–e) and LLaDA-V (f–h). For each image, the baseline caption (top, cream) and the Vigor caption (bottom, sage) are produced by the same model under the same generation length and block schedule; Vigor only reorders the commitment of masked positions at inference. Hallucinated object words in the baseline caption are highlighted in red . On Lumina-DiMOO, the baseline invents an oven and bowl around a pizza (a), fabricates a tabletop scattered with books, phone, bag, cup, and plant (b), turns a winter bird scene into something with an orange bird and people (c), inserts a bench into a zoo scene (d), and adds a sandwich to a banquet table (e); in every case Vigor removes the invented objects while still describing the visible scene. On LLaDA-V, the baseline imagines a glass and bottle behind a donut that is actually next to a soda can (f), hallucinates a person sitting on a bed on a truck-shaped cake (g), and adds a refrigerator to a kitchen that has only cabinets and a microwave (h); Vigor keeps to the visible objects in each case. Vigor captions are not shorter than the baselines, indicating that the improvement does not come from producing less detailed descriptions.
blocks.zh: 图5显示Lumina-DimoO(a-e)和LLaDA-V(f-h)的八个案例研究。 对于每个图像,基线标题(顶部,奶油)和Vigor标题(底部,贤者)都是由同一个模型在相同的一代长度和块表下生成的;Vigor只在推断时重排蒙面位置的承诺. 基线标题中的迷幻对象字以红色突出显示。 在Lumina-DimoO上,基线发明了比萨饼(a)周围的烤箱和碗,用书籍、电话、袋、杯子和植物(b)编织散落的桌子,将冬季鸟类场景变成橙色鸟类和人(c)的东西,在动物园场景(d)中插入长凳,并在宴会桌(e)中加入三明治;在每一种情况下,Vigor都会去除被发明的物体,同时仍然描述可见的场景. 在LLaDA-V上,基线想象到一个甜甜圈后面的玻璃和瓶子,实际上就在汽水罐(f)旁边,幻觉一个人坐在卡车形状的蛋糕(g)上的床上,并在厨房里添加一个只有柜子和微波炉(h)的冰箱;维戈尔在每种情况下都保留着可见物体. 警示标题不短于基线,表明改进并非来自制作较不详细的说明。
